dealSummary: Beijing-based Moonshot AI raised a $3.5 billion round at a $35 billion valuation from investors including The National Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund, Bloomberg reported.
leadInvestors: The National Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund

dealSummary: Generalist, a robotics startup developing models for robots to perform dexterous tasks, is in talks to raise a new round led by 8VC at a $3 billion valuation, Business Insider reported.
ThreatLocker, a provider of Zero Trust cybersecurity software, secured a $190 million Series F led by Elephant.
CAIS, the developer of an alternative investment platform for financial advisers, raised a $170 million Series D led by Vista Equity Partners that valued the company at over $2 billion.
leadInvestors: Vista Equity Partners that valued the company at over $2 billion

dealSummary: Dwelly, a London-based startup building an AI operating system for residential lettings, raised a $170 million Series B led by EQT Growth and General Catalyst.
Eliyan, a developer of connectivity technology for AI infrastructure, closed a $145 million Series C led by Seligman Ventures at a $1 billion valuation.
San Francisco-based Freehand, which develops agents to manage supply chain spending for large enterprises, raised a $75 million round led by Battery Ventures and NewRoad Capital Partners.
Encore AI, a customer-interaction platform specialist, raised a $30 million Series A led by Team8, Planven and The Garage.
UK-based defense tech startup Agon received $30 million from investors including Lakestar, Lux Capital and Northzone.
London-based Greyparrot, an AI waste-analytics specialist, raised a $27 million Series B led by Omar Mir.
Xeltis, a Dutch developer of artificial vessels and valves, raised €20.5 million in a round led by Horizon 3 Healthcare.
Toronto-based Terminal, which develops data infrastructure for the insurance, fleet management and logistics industries, closed a $20 million Series A led by Battery Ventures.
Qureight, a UK-based quantitative imaging startup, raised a $20 million Series B led by Molten Ventures.
